messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident P-2026-7723 fired — SEV1 — AZ2 egress network flap causing 5xx errors and elevated latency. Auto-escalation to oncall-sre. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P-2026-7723
Maya Chen: ack - I'm oncall for az2, taking lead. Starting triage now. Can someone paste the quick runbook for egress flaps?
Liam O'Connor: thanks @Maya — I'm on rotation, standing by for handoff. Metrics look like a sudden outbound packet loss spike around 10:23 UTC, 503s from edge->egress pool.
Priya Patel: seeing 18% error rate on serving for az2, requests to customer-facing cluster failing. Support slack thread filling. Recommend prepare failover routing and customer advisory.
Dan Morales: running initial checks on fabric and egress gateways. No recent deploys in az2. Confirming NAT gateway and router health now.
Maya Chen: ok, if fabric is healthy we should activate routing fallback. Priya, can you coordinate status page? Liam, be ready to run the reroute if ops approves.
Priya Patel: on it — will post a preliminary "degraded" notice once we confirm reroute plan. Pinged SE-ops.
Dan Morales: fabric looks healthy, but outbound qcons dropped on egress node set-3. Suspect egress gateway degraded. Plan: divert 60% traffic to az5, 40% remain to az2, then iterate.
Liam O'Connor: ready. Executing gradual reroute now. Command:
```
# routediverge: shift traffic from az2 -> az5
rdrctl routing modify --from=az2 --to=az5 --weight-to=0.6 --strategy=gradual --window=120s
# scale egress pool in az5
rdrctl capacity scale --zone=az5 --pool=egress --delta=+4
```
ops-bot: Automated action: routing change detected by autopilot, plan id rdp-9921. Approvals: auto-approved for P1.
pagerduty-bot: Incident update: routediverge initiated by Liam O'Connor. Notifying escalation policy level 2.
Priya Patel: posted initial status on status.redwood.ai: "We are experiencing elevated error rates in AZ2 outbound egress. Traffic is being rerouted to reduce customer impact. Engineers are investigating." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-04
Maya Chen: monitoring: error rate dropping from 18% -> 7% within 90s of reroute.
Dan Morales: increased az5 egress capacity, queues look stable. No sign of backend degradation.
Liam O'Connor: continuing to move traffic. New weights -> az2:0.3 az5:0.7
Maya Chen: error rate now at ~2.1%, p95 latency back to baseline. Good sign.
Priya Patel: Support update: top 12 customers had some failed requests, we've opened support tickets and alerted customer success on high-value accounts.
Maya Chen: marking incident as mitigated, moving to containment -> next steps: postmortem, router egress investigation, consider circuit-level retries & backoff tuning.
Dan Morales: created bug: RT-4782 "egress gateway degrade under sudden outbound burst" and assigned to eng-runtime.
Liam O'Connor: handing back oncall to rotation, filing notes in the incident runbook.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone. I'll keep the status page in maintenance mode until we've validated stability for 30m. Please add any follow-ups to the incident doc.
support-bot: Posted customer-facing update: "Traffic restored for most customers; targeted reroute in progress. Investigating root cause."
ops-bot: Autopilot note: fallback policy executed, traffic rebalanced. Monitoring for reflow/evictions.
pagerduty-bot: Incident P-2026-7723 — mitigation confirmed. Closing workflow will start once stability window (30m) completes.
Maya Chen: resolved/monitoring. Filing postmortem template now. :white_check_mark:
Liam O'Connor: ack and thanks — will add timing and commands used to the doc.
Priya Patel: good job team. We'll follow up with a customer impact summary and timeline.
